negativeTests.scenario: Request or seed data names a supplier as customer seller
negativeTests.expected: Reject or ignore the value; customer counterparty remains Company

negativeTests.scenario: A supplier payment account is attached to customer checkout
negativeTests.expected: Reject without creating a payment path

negativeTests.scenario: A second customer-facing merchant Company is created
negativeTests.expected: Unique invariant rejects the write

negativeTests.scenario: A franchisee registration or admin route is introduced
negativeTests.expected: Contract scan fails

negativeTests.scenario: A regional split-settlement capability is introduced
negativeTests.expected: Contract scan fails

negativeTests.scenario: A Franchisee or RegionalMerchant entity is introduced
negativeTests.expected: Schema guard fails

negativeTests.scenario: The same normalized credit code is submitted twice
negativeTests.expected: Return conflict and preserve the first application

negativeTests.scenario: A DRAFT supplier is approved without submission
negativeTests.expected: Return 409 and keep DRAFT

negativeTests.scenario: The same registration idempotency key is replayed with the same body
negativeTests.expected: Return the original result without a second supplier

negativeTests.scenario: Required qualification or pickup data is missing at submit
negativeTests.expected: Return validation details and keep the draft editable

negativeTests.scenario: Supplier A requests Supplier B object by id
negativeTests.expected: Return scope-forbidden without object data

negativeTests.scenario: Client supplies or alters supplierId during login or mutation
negativeTests.expected: Ignore or reject the client value and use session-bound supplierId

negativeTests.scenario: Supplier A requests an export containing Supplier B rows
negativeTests.expected: Reject before export creation

negativeTests.scenario: Cross-supplier id is probed to distinguish existing and missing objects
negativeTests.expected: Return a non-enumerating scope-safe response

negativeTests.scenario: Account-admin session calls a pricing or inventory operation
negativeTests.expected: Return 403 with no state change

negativeTests.scenario: A functional account grants itself a higher account type
negativeTests.expected: Reject and append a security audit event

negativeTests.scenario: The final active owner account admin is suspended
negativeTests.expected: Reject and keep the account active

negativeTests.scenario: Sensitive account change lacks second verification
negativeTests.expected: Return precondition-required without mutation

negativeTests.scenario: A sensitive operation succeeds without an AuditLog append
negativeTests.expected: Transaction fails or the contract test fails

negativeTests.scenario: Existing audit before/after snapshots are updated
negativeTests.expected: Reject the write; audit history remains append-only

negativeTests.scenario: Client supplies actorId or applicantId
negativeTests.expected: Ignore or reject it and bind the authenticated identity

negativeTests.scenario: Sensitive operation has no requestId correlation
negativeTests.expected: Reject or fail the audit completeness assertion

negativeTests.scenario: Unauthorized role requests a sensitive field group
negativeTests.expected: Return FIELD_FORBIDDEN and omit the field

negativeTests.scenario: A valid account reuses a different workspace API
negativeTests.expected: Return WORKSPACE_FORBIDDEN before resource lookup

negativeTests.scenario: A public or customer DTO includes supply-price or payable data
negativeTests.expected: Response-whitelist test fails

negativeTests.scenario: High-sensitivity export is downloaded without approval
negativeTests.expected: Return approval-required and no file

negativeTests.scenario: Generated or runtime public response includes a forbidden internal field
negativeTests.expected: Contract generation or Supertest whitelist fails

negativeTests.scenario: Two OpenAPI generations differ byte-for-byte
negativeTests.expected: Generation check fails

negativeTests.scenario: A breaking contract change is introduced without baseline process
negativeTests.expected: Locked oasdiff gate fails

negativeTests.scenario: A mini-program bypasses miniapp-kit and calls wx.request directly
negativeTests.expected: Transport-boundary test fails

negativeTests.scenario: Company admin exposes public self-registration
negativeTests.expected: Route and API contract scan fails

negativeTests.scenario: A multi-account identity is sent directly to a workspace
negativeTests.expected: Require account selection before session issuance

negativeTests.scenario: One session activates two functionalAccountIds
negativeTests.expected: Reject the second activation or revoke the old context

negativeTests.scenario: Disabled account is selected
negativeTests.expected: Return WORKSPACE_FORBIDDEN without a business session

negativeTests.scenario: Company account manually opens another role route
negativeTests.expected: Return permission-denied and load no foreign data

negativeTests.scenario: A workspace menu includes another role module
negativeTests.expected: Page contract test fails

negativeTests.scenario: A role calls an endpoint outside its permission set
negativeTests.expected: Return 403 before object lookup

negativeTests.scenario: A session cookie is reused after role switching
negativeTests.expected: Old session is revoked and the call is unauthenticated

negativeTests.scenario: A company workspace omits loading, empty, error or denied state
negativeTests.expected: Page acceptance contract fails

negativeTests.scenario: Two role pages share active menu or query context
negativeTests.expected: Isolation test fails

negativeTests.scenario: Error state renders token, supplier price or internal stack data
negativeTests.expected: Redaction test fails

negativeTests.scenario: Login or account-selection request carries another supplierId
negativeTests.expected: Ignore or reject the value; bind server-side ownership

negativeTests.scenario: Unapproved application receives a normal supplier business session
negativeTests.expected: Return progress-only state without workspace access

negativeTests.scenario: Multi-role supplier identity bypasses account selection
negativeTests.expected: Require account selection

negativeTests.scenario: Suspended or exited supplier attempts business login
negativeTests.expected: Deny session issuance

negativeTests.scenario: Supplier role opens another role route or API
negativeTests.expected: Return 403 and load no foreign module data

negativeTests.scenario: Supplier role requests another supplier object
negativeTests.expected: Return scope-forbidden before lookup result

negativeTests.scenario: Multiple supplier role menus are merged into one workspace
negativeTests.expected: Page contract test fails

negativeTests.scenario: Old supplier role session is reused after switching roles
negativeTests.expected: Old session is revoked

negativeTests.scenario: Same identityType+identityId applies and reviews through two accounts
negativeTests.expected: Reject review with no state change

negativeTests.scenario: Super admin attempts to bypass required second-person review
negativeTests.expected: Reject exactly as for other roles

negativeTests.scenario: Two reviewers approve the same version concurrently
negativeTests.expected: Exactly one update succeeds; the other gets conflict

negativeTests.scenario: Login, account selection, sensitive reveal, export or session revocation lacks audit
negativeTests.expected: Contract test fails or transaction is rejected
